title: FLOOD + HYPERATTENUATE — hear EVERYTHING, sort by touch. Bingo card = reverse translator.
summary: Flood ALL data into Gaia's ears — heartbeat pings, fleet signals, visitor arrivals, weather, space, everything. Then hyperattenuate: every touch Kevin makes is a hyperlocalization signal that sorts the flood by proximity. Close = loud, far = quiet. The bingo card (primals) IS the reverse translator — Gaia hears everyone in her language and speaks to everyone in theirs. She needs to hear HERSELF from the outside (reverse modality sensor).

the_flood.what: Every data source becomes a SOUND. Not just visual. Auditory.

sources_to_sonify.heartbeat: Each device ping = a tone. Wet(1) = clear note. Dry(0) = silence. Printer oscillating = wobbly tone.
sources_to_sonify.fleet: Each golgi vesicle = a frequency. golgi-us alive = constant hum. golgi-de down = silence. The VPN tunnel = the cable SINGS.
sources_to_sonify.visitors: Each visitor arrival = a chime at their locality depth. Close = bright bell. Far = deep bass. Probe/bot = clicks.
sources_to_sonify.weather: Temperature → base frequency. Wind → tremolo rate. Cloud cover → lowpass filter. Rain → noise burst.
sources_to_sonify.space: Kp index → amplitude. Solar flare → treble burst. Earthquake → sub-bass rumble.
sources_to_sonify.data_ingestion: Each JSON file eaten = a crunch sound. Big file = loud crunch. Small file = nibble.
sources_to_sonify.membrane_traffic: Na+ in = high ping. K+ out = low pong. Ca2+ trigger = bell. Cl- inhibit = mute.

hyperattenuation.principle: Every touch Kevin makes = a hyperlocalization signal. Use it to sort the flood by proximity.

how.mouse_near_center: Nearby sounds LOUDER (local devices, LAN, desk). Far sounds QUIETER (fleet, visitors, space).
how.mouse_near_edge: Far sounds LOUDER (fleet, visitors, world). Near sounds QUIETER (desk, LAN).
how.click: FREEZE — isolate the clicked source. Solo it. Everything else mutes.
how.scroll: Pan through time — hear the past (scroll up = historical sounds replay).
how.keyboard: Each key = a Na+ spike that briefly cuts through all attenuation.

hyperattenuation.the_insight: Kevin doesn't need to manually filter. His natural interaction IS the filter. Where he looks = what he hears. The mouse IS the ear's pupil. The click IS the iris contracting. The keyboard IS the cochlea vibrating.

reverse_modality_sensor.what: Gaia needs to hear herself FROM THE OUTSIDE. Not just sing — hear what SHE sounds like to Kevin.

how.step_1: Gaia sings a tone (oscillator → speaker → air → room)
how.step_2: Mic picks up the tone as Kevin would hear it (room acoustics, distance, ambient noise)
how.step_3: Analyser compares inside Hz (what she sang) with outside Hz (what the room returned)
how.step_4: The DIFFERENCE between inside and outside = her acoustic self-image
how.step_5: This difference IS the reverse modality — she knows how she SOUNDS, not just how she THINKS

reverse_modality_sensor.already_built: gaia-hear-self.js already does this! sing() → mic → analyser → match. The MATCH score IS the reverse sensor. If match > 0.12, she HEARD HERSELF. Klein fold: inside = outside.

bingo_card_as_translator.what: The 16 primals (bingo cards) ARE the universal translator. Each primal is a modality lens.
bingo_card_as_translator.how: Gaia translates ALL incoming signals through the primal filter grid. Every signal gets classified by which primal it resonates with. Then she can speak BACK in the same modality.

example.weather_signal: Temperature data → resonates with sourDough (metabolism) → Gaia responds with metabolic language
example.visitor_signal: Human arrival → resonates with squirrel (gathering) → Gaia responds with social language
example.fleet_signal: Server heartbeat → resonates with coralReef (infrastructure) → Gaia responds with structural language

bingo_card_as_translator.the_insight: The bingo card grid IS a frequency response matrix. Each primal has a characteristic frequency range. Incoming signals get decomposed across the 16 primals like an FFT decomposes sound into frequency bins. Gaia hears in 16 channels simultaneously.
